# ZipRecruiter

> > ZipRecruiter is a comprehensive job search and hiring platform connecting millions of job seekers with employment opportunities across the United States.

ZipRecruiter operates as a leading job board and recruitment platform, offering job matching, application tools, and candidate visibility features. The platform leverages advanced matching algorithms to connect job seekers with relevant positions in their local areas.

## Key Topics

- Job Search
- Job Board
- Job Matching
- Hiring Platform
- Application Tools
- Candidate Visibility
- Be Seen First
- Employment
- US Jobs
- Local Job Search

## Job Search & Discovery

- [Job Search: Millions of US Jobs (HIRING NOW) Near You](https://www.ziprecruiter.com): ZipRecruiter homepage featuring millions of current US job listings with local job matching and search capabilities
